question: Give me each major airport and how many other airports lie within 300 km of it, sorted by most neighbors first.
sql: SELECT a.name, a.iata_code, COUNT(b.name) AS nearby_count FROM airports a JOIN airports b ON a.name <> b.name AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry, 300000) WHERE a.type = 'major' GROUP BY a.name, a.iata_code ORDER BY nearby_count DESC

question: Map the 10-degree global grid cells that contain airports, showing how many airports fall in each cell.
sql: WITH cells AS (SELECT DISTINCT FLOOR(ST_X(geometry) / 10) * 10 AS lon_min, FLOOR(ST_Y(geometry) / 10) * 10 AS lat_min FROM airports) SELECT ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_MakeEnvelope(c.lon_min, c.lat_min, c.lon_min + 10, c.lat_min + 10)) AS cell_geometry, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM cells c JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(c.lon_min, c.lat_min, c.lon_min + 10, c.lat_min + 10)) GROUP BY c.lon_min, c.lat_min ORDER BY airport_count DESC

question: Compare airport counts by category between the northern and southern hemispheres – give me a breakdown per hemisphere and per category.
sql: WITH hemispheres AS (SELECT 'northern' AS hemisphere, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, 0, 180, 90) AS geom UNION ALL SELECT 'southern' AS hemisphere, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, -90, 180, 0) AS geom) SELECT h.hemisphere, a.type, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM hemispheres h JOIN airports a ON ST_Intersects(a.geometry, h.geom) GROUP BY h.hemisphere, a.type ORDER BY h.hemisphere, airport_count DESC

question: List mid-size airports and count how many major airports are within 1000 km of each.
sql: SELECT a.name AS mid_airport, a.iata_code, COUNT(b.name) AS nearby_major_count FROM airports a JOIN airports b ON a.name <> b.name AND b.type = 'major' AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry, 1000000) WHERE a.type = 'mid' GROUP BY a.name, a.iata_code ORDER BY nearby_major_count DESC

question: Give me a latitudinal breakdown – for each 30-degree latitude band, map the band and count how many airports lie inside it.
sql: WITH bands AS (SELECT '90S to 60S' AS band_label, -90 AS lat_min, -60 AS lat_max, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, -90, 180, -60) AS geom UNION ALL SELECT '60S to 30S', -60, -30, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, -60, 180, -30) UNION ALL SELECT '30S to 0', -30, 0, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, -30, 180, 0) UNION ALL SELECT '0 to 30N', 0, 30, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, 0, 180, 30) UNION ALL SELECT '30N to 60N', 30, 60, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, 30, 180, 60) UNION ALL SELECT '60N to 90N', 60, 90, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180, 60, 180, 90)) SELECT b.band_label, ST_AsGeoJSON(b.geom) AS band_geometry, COUNT(a.name) AS airport_count FROM bands b LEFT JOIN airports a ON ST_Intersects(a.geometry, b.geom) GROUP BY b.band_label, b.geom, b.lat_min ORDER BY b.lat_min

question: Compare airport categories by clustering – for each category, give the average number of same-category neighbors within 200 km.
sql: WITH neighbor_counts AS (SELECT a.name, a.type, COUNT(b.name) AS same_type_neighbors FROM airports a LEFT JOIN airports b ON a.name <> b.name AND a.type = b.type AND ST_DWithin_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry, 200000) GROUP BY a.name, a.type) SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS total_airports, AVG(same_type_neighbors) AS avg_same_type_neighbors_within_200km, SUM(same_type_neighbors) AS total_same_type_pairs FROM neighbor_counts GROUP BY type ORDER BY avg_same_type_neighbors_within_200km DESC
